_evidence: MEASURED (config.json + one safetensors header + a full byte-exact SHA256 comparison of the embed_tokens/lm_head tensor pair, not a shape-only guess). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY. Smallest language specimen in the ModelLake -- a first anatomy data point for S003's Resident/Pulsar-candidate evaluation framework (discovery-only; full qualification battery remains gated on G004/G005). Also a second, independent transfer test of this session's R-tied-embedding-dedup-verify rule.

architecture_CONFIRMED_FROM_TENSORS.finding: q_proj output dim is 2048 (16 heads x 128 head_dim), 2.0x the hidden_size (1024) -- a real Qwen3-small-model design choice (preserving per-head capacity at small hidden_size rather than the naive hidden_size/n_heads split), confirmed from actual tensor shapes, not the config field alone.

TIED_EMBEDDING_SECOND_TRANSFER_TEST.finding: CONFIRMS R-tied-embedding-dedup-verify (originally single-specimen, from CAND-iLLaDA-8B) on a SECOND, completely unrelated model family: 296.8 MiB (20.7% of total checkpoint bytes) is a verified, exact duplicate of embed_tokens.weight stored as lm_head.weight. Contrast with pi0_base (also tied, earlier this session), which stored its equivalent tied weight ONLY ONCE -- so this is a real per-checkpoint packaging choice, not a universal HF convention either way, but now 2-of-3 tied-embedding specimens surveyed this session waste the duplicate.

byte_accounting_EXACT.finding: raw stored params are 25.3% over the '0.6B' name; deduplicating the tied lm_head brings it to 0.66% -- the SAME reconciliation mechanism as iLLaDA-8B's 8.28%->0.065% finding earlier this session, now a pattern with two independent confirmations rather than one.

obvious_representation_opportunities: Same as iLLaDA: the duplicate lm_head.weight is exact, zero-capability-cost reclaimable space -- 20.7% of this checkpoint's stored bytes.

At 0.6B params this is the smallest specimen surveyed this session by a wide margin -- genuinely cheap to fully qualify as a Resident/Pulsar candidate once G004/G005 unlock that framework; this pass only established anatomy, not capability.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No Doctor capability battery, no HCLI WorkUnit qualification run (both explicitly gated on G004/G005 per the standing resource law, not attempted here).
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN / FUTURE QUALIFICATION CANDIDATE. Anatomy-only pass, correctly stopping short of the gated qualification battery. Strengthens R-tied-embedding-dedup-verify to a 2-specimen-confirmed general finding.
